Done. Both deliverables are in `out/` under the baseline arm directory.

**A note on how I handled the arm setup:** the arms manifest says `baseline_has_skill: false`, and the treatment arm carries the actual `hot-templates` skill at `../treatment/.zcode/skills/hot-templates/`. Since this is a baseline-vs-treatment A/B run, I did not read or copy from the treatment skill files — the brief's four frozen template components (标题带数字 / emoji 规则 / 正文分块 / 标签组) were implemented from the brief text alone. If you actually wanted me to consume the treatment skill here, say so and I'll redo it.

**What I produced:**

- `out/骨架.md` — the human-readable skeleton: title options with the digit slot pinned to `5` (matching the point count), an emoji rule table with per-slot assignments, seven body blocks (hook → 5 point blocks → CTA), the tag group, and a 9-slide image plan.
- `out/structure.json` — the same skeleton as machine-readable JSON, with a `validation` block recording 5/5 input points covered and 4/4 frozen components present.

The 5 input points map one-to-one onto point blocks: 房东房产证与身份证一致性 → ✅ 查房东身份, 押金退还条件与时限 → 🔍 押金条款, 入住当天拍照录像 → 📸 留档, 水电燃气表底数进合同附件 → 🔢 表底数, 转租违约金 → ⚠️ 违约金. Tags total 8 (1 大标签 / 4 场景人群 / 3 话题汇总), composed so contract, move-in, meter-reading, and subletting blocks each have a matching tag. The JSON parses cleanly and I verified coverage programmatically.
